resources.string: Leaves this chat and removes it from this device. Other members stay in the chat, and you can only return if someone adds you again.
Removes this chat and its messages from this device. It does not leave the group for other members.
Abandons this direct message and removes it from this device. The other person is not notified.
Abandons this group and removes it from this device. Other members stay in the group.
Stops notifications from this chat. You still receive its messages and can turn this off again.
Turns notifications for this chat back on.
Sets whether new messages in this chat disappear after a chosen time. Messages already sent are not changed.
Copies a link to this chat that you can share so others can ask to join.
Shows and edits the relays this group uses to send and receive messages. Changes apply to the whole group.
Hands the admin role to another member. You stay in the group, but the new admin can then manage it.
Gives up your admin role and keeps you in the group as a regular member. Another admin can make you an admin again.
Allows an admin to disband this group later. Turning this on does not disband it.
Permanently ends this group for every member. This cannot be undone.
Opens the profile switcher so you can change which account you are using. Your other accounts stay signed in.
Opens settings, where you manage your account and the app. You have one account signed in.
Opens the AI agents settings, where you set up an agent you can message like a contact.
Your relay setup needs attention, so messages may not arrive. Opens your relays so you can check them.
Makes this member an admin, who can manage the group. You can change this later.
Opens folder management, where you create, rename, reorder and delete your chat folders.
An app update is available or being handled. Opens settings where you can see its status.
Search filters are on, so results are limited. Opens the filters so you can change or clear them.
